summary.text: Han Dong blessed land is the rank six transformation path immortal aperture left after Gu Immortal Han Dong dies in Tai Qiu.

claims.text: The whole terrain is a shallow beach. Jade green water less than three meters deep runs among large piled rocks that look like ink strokes on a canvas. Pools of green water form lakes and tiny seas in a chessboard pattern. The water shares one source through crevices between the rocks. Fish, prawns, aquatic insects, mortal Gu, seashells, mussels, and seaweed live there. Most abundant are pinkish red spirit snakes about the size of an adult’s thumb, some only a few centimeters.

Han Dong is one of the Traveling Three Elites and a transformation path rank six Gu Immortal; the blessed land is rank six. Its land spirit is a pinkish red spirit snake, translucent without scales, pink flesh, no bones, and one red line from head to tail. It hisses in hostility until Fang Yuan tricks it into accepting Lu Qing Ming, then transfers ownership to himself.

Under cooperation from the pinkish red spirit snake, Fang Yuan annexes Han Dong blessed land into the sovereign immortal aperture. He moves the whole environment over, so fish, prawns, and plants need no adaptation. The blessed land’s main valuable product is spirit snakes, already nurtured to desolate beast level despite low grade development. The land spirit remains on the rock beach after annexation. Perceivable dao Immortal Gu had shown about seven thousand transformation path dao marks as the largest count, with water and earth path about a thousand each and mixed lesser marks; Fang Yuan absorbs all of them as the blessed land fuses. The annexation skips the sixth earthly calamity and jumps him forward by four calamities.
